title: Quasicrystals
description: Order without repetition: an alloy with the five-fold symmetry crystallography said was impossible. Unlocks aluminium and the Quasicrystal Furnace.

puzzle.goal: A Penrose tiling is laid from N rhombs of side s, each with a corner angle A. Write the area a it covers.
puzzle.name: Rhomb area
puzzle.ask: Find a for N = @{N} fat rhombs, s = @{s} and A = @{A} (72°).
puzzle.method: A rhomb is two triangles: its area is s²·sin A. The fat and thin ones (72° and 36°) tile the plane, never repeating.
